user.title: Victron Charge Control
user.description: Select your Victron and EPEX Spot entities. Fields marked required must be configured. Optional fields can be left empty. The expected units are shown in each label.

data.epex_spot_entity: EPEX Spot price sensor (required, ct/kWh or EUR/kWh)
data.dc_coupled_pv_feed_in_entity: DC coupled PV feed-in switch (optional, on/off)

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Select the battery state of charge sensor in percent (0-100%), for example GX Device - DC battery charge. Used to enforce the minimum and maximum battery charge levels.
data_description.grid_setpoint_entity: Select the writable Victron ESS AC power setpoint in watts (W), for example GX Device - AC power setpoint. Positive values request grid import; negative values request grid export.
data_description.epex_spot_entity: Select the EPEX Spot market price sensor in ct/kWh or EUR/kWh, for example EPEX Spot Data - Market Price. It must also provide the forecast price data in its attributes for automatic scheduling.
data_description.max_grid_feed_in_entity: Select the writable Victron ESS maximum feed-in power limit in watts (W), for example GX Device - ESS max feed-in power. Used to limit grid export when price-based feed-in control is enabled.
data_description.grid_consumption_entity: Select a cumulative grid import energy meter in kilowatt-hours (kWh) for energy and cost tracking. Leave empty to skip import tracking.
data_description.grid_feed_in_energy_entity: Select a cumulative grid export energy meter in kilowatt-hours (kWh) for energy and revenue tracking. Leave empty to skip export tracking.
data_description.solar_surplus_entity: Select a power sensor measuring available solar surplus in watts (W). Its 15-minute average supports surplus-aware discharge and PV charging. Leave empty if you do not use these features.
data_description.dc_coupled_pv_feed_in_entity: Select the Victron DC-coupled PV feed-in switch, for example GX Device - DC-coupled PV - feed in excess. This is an on/off switch with no unit. When DC feed-in control is enabled, it is turned off in reduced feed-in mode and on in normal mode. Leave empty to skip this control.

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found. Make sure it exists.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only one instance is supported.

data_description.safety_startup_grace_seconds: Startup grace period in seconds (0-600; default 90). Temporarily tolerates missing or unavailable battery SOC and grid setpoint states after startup or reload. Ends early when both report valid states. Set to 0 to disable startup grace.
